metadata.description: Codex image generation, editing, vision and subagents for Claude Code, powered by your existing Codex CLI login.

plugins.name: codex-bridge
plugins.description: Let Claude Code use Codex's image features — generate and edit images (gpt-image-2, native transparency), let Codex look at screenshots, and delegate review/debugging/bulk work to Codex subagents — all through your existing Codex CLI ChatGPT login, always on the newest model in your Codex catalog. No OpenAI API key required.
